name: Alfons Sylvatica
original_name: アルフォンス・シルベチカ
source:
He is a hedonist who lives a decadent and spoiled life. He belongs to Crown.

He is as elusive as a phantom, with ephemeral pleasures as his first priority.

He is consistently dishonest and will play you for a fool.

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Snow White's Mirror

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#alfons]official website[/url]]
